description: Every Atlas header of §9.6.3 (AP-HTTP-001): its field lines (several lines are joined with ", ", RFC 9110 section 5.3); for a Structured Field, `sf` is its RFC 9651 parse in the form of github.com/httpwg/structured-field-tests (null when it does not parse as its type); `value` is what Atlas reads from it; `absent` means a receiver treats the header as absent (§9.6.3: one that does not parse as its type), with `why`. A value that parses as its Structured Field type but breaks the grammar §9.6.3 gives it is absent too (Q-HDR-1). Atlas-Client-Features lists every member, empty when the header leaves it out.

cases.name: Atlas-Client: name="fiatlas";build=7, version="2.3.0", protocol="atlas/...
cases.note: unknown members and parameters are ignored

cases.name: Atlas-Client: name=fiatlas, version="2.3.0", protocol="atlas/1.0"
cases.note: name is a Token, not a String

expected.why: not a Structured Field dictionary: trailing , in dictionary
not a Structured Field dictionary: bad key

cases.name: Atlas-Client: name="fiatlas", version="2.3.0", protocol="atlas/1.0", na...
cases.note: a repeated key: the last value wins (RFC 9651)

cases.name: Atlas-Client-Features: levels=(core streaming columnar bulk events handoff), han...
lines: levels=(core streaming columnar bulk events handoff), handoff=(snowflake-arrow/1 reach-snowflake), lens=(rename alias_value convert_unit promote default drop), deliveries=(single chunked subscription operation transfer), encodings=(json ndjson arrow csv parquet)

cases.name: Atlas-Client-Features: levels=(core)
cases.note: a member left out is empty

cases.name: Atlas-Client-Features: levels=(core warp), future=(x y)
cases.note: an unknown token is kept and ignored when acting; an unknown member is ignored

cases.name: Atlas-Client-Features: levels=core

expected.why: levels is not an Inner List

cases.note: a Token where an Inner List is required

expected.why: levels holds something other than a Token
not a Structured Field dictionary: expected SP or ) in inner list

cases.name: Atlas-Client-Features: levels=(Core)
cases.note: tokens are case-sensitive: Core is not core, so no level is known
